ruling.recommended_action: Refund $9.45 (voucher) for the two unexempted detour segments (6.70 km × $1.4101/km); no account flag warranted (driver profile shows 0 upheld route disputes in 90 d).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: no chat messages [F8]; the driver's post-trip statement [F9] recounts a traffic obstruction — no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation. Nothing else in the complaint or statement is safety-relevant. safety_concern = none.

Route deviation (RydeTAXI — metered, so extra distance flows into the fare): two off-route segments, [F3] 21:42–21:49 (+2.69 km) and [F4] 22:02–22:09 (+3.13 km); total +6.7 km / +42% [F1]. The driver invokes "reasonable cause" (RD-4) [F9]. RD-4 requires traffic evidence targeted at the replaced portion of the optimal route. Here the only incident is [F12] — an accident at 21:26 on Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway (towards TPE) after Sheares Avenue Exit, 0 m from the optimal route, i.e. reported before both segments and inside the trip window (21:38–22:12). The detail "Avoid lane 2" indicates a single lane restriction, not a road block, and the corroborating bands [F10] PIE band 5 (40–49 km/h) and [F11] KPH band 4 (30–39 km/h) are both moderate, not band 1–2 (RD-4(b) is corroborating only and cannot exempt on its own). Neither segment is placed by any record on KPH; the first detour reaches 1084 m from the optimal route and the driver's own account gives no named alternative tying the driven road to KPH. Nothing places either segment elsewhere either, so no exemption can be established and no consent exists at all: no chat at all [F8], and the driver's claimed verbal justification is a statement, not rider consent (RD-5, G11). Both segments therefore count as unexempted under RD-1/RD-2.

Arithmetic (RD-2, RydeTAXI): unexempted extra km = 2.69 + 3.13 = 5.82 km by segment, but the fare's excess-distance figure uses the integrity-checked total of 6.70 km [F5], billed at this trip's own per-km rate $31.84 ÷ 22.58 km = $1.4101/km → 6.70 × 1.4101 = $9.45. Refund that amount; the residual route-corridor/jitter distance that is not attributed to any segment is not refunded. Waiting fee $0.00 [F7] and platform fee $1.47 are published items, nothing extra to waive; ERP/toll field absent, so FARE-2 untriggered.

Account flag: RD-6 requires refund > 0 (met) AND route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1. Driver profile [F15] shows 1 dispute, 1 upheld, of which route: 0 — so no upheld route dispute. flag_account not applied.

Evidence status: sufficient — GPS segments with times, complete fare data, and a traffic incident tied to the optimal route; no missing record changes the outcome.

segment_findings.reason: RD-4 not satisfied: the only incident [F12] is on KPH, a motorway where an 'avoid lane 2' restriction is not a block, and no record ties the 21:42–21:49 segment (up to 1084 m off the optimal route) to any road; bands [F10][F11] are moderate (band 5 / band 4) and cannot exempt alone. No rider consent: no chat messages at all [F8]; the driver's claimed rationale is a post-trip statement, not consent (RD-5, G11). Segment counts under RD-1/RD-2.

Second off-route loop 22:02–22:09 (up to 997 m off route, +3.13 km). Same analysis: the RD-4 incident occurred at 21:26 with only a lane-2 advisory, and nothing in the record places this segment on KPH or on any route the rider agreed to. No consent appears in the chat [F8]. Segment counts under RD-1/RD-2.
